result.activation_assessment: Do not propose activation. The trial is consistent with utility for this exact repository-publication scope, but it lacks a deterministic protected-baseline comparison sufficient for VERIFIED_FOR_SCOPE evidence.
result.actual_result_assessment: The scoped trial completed its bounded publication successfully: a closed 80-path allowlist, exact-head CI, expected-head merge, and 80-of-80 remote blob readback preserved source and claim boundaries despite a noisy worktree and a lease-generation renewal.
evidence_for_candidate: The committed delta exactly matched the closed 80-path native-record allowlist and excluded semantic state, inbox, strategy, protocol, baseline, source, tests, prompts, Candidate authority, temporary projections, and stale-owner response files.
Native verification, structured-data parsing, append-only event-prefix, forbidden-path, secret-marker, and stale-generation-response checks passed.

Exact head 7ad6ee206a65a3c83f193d866a01765baf4e6ab9 passed all four pytest shards and the dependent aggregate, merged only with expected-head protection, and all 80 reviewed remote main blobs matched.
evidence_limits: The trial measured publication hygiene and durability only; it did not compare the Candidate against the active prompt on protected behavioral outcomes.
No scientist-agent system, original method, O-adapted mechanism, or untested family member was executed, so no mechanism-level or family-level inference is supported.
INSUFFICIENT_EQUIVALENCE_EVIDENCE remains limited to the named static artifact-to-contract audit and is not a behavioral negative.
Repository-operated CI and readback are not independent production capability evidence.
next_evidence_needed: A precommitted protected comparison on repository-development tasks where context hygiene can change an objectively scored outcome.
Deterministic regression-gate recomputation before any scoped activation proposal.
Preservation of Revision-20 scope rules in every negative-evidence interpretation.
result.rollback: Keep the Candidate inactive. If a later protected comparison shows no benefit or a regression, record the exact scope and configuration, preserve contradictory evidence, and reject only for that tested scope without generalizing beyond it.
